ios.desc:
ThoughtTrack is a calm space for capturing fleeting thoughts before they slip away.

Speak your mind, and let go. Your thoughts drift into the background, resurfacing gently when the context is right—not when an arbitrary timer goes off.

THE PROBLEM WITH TRADITIONAL REMINDERS
Most reminder apps demand your attention at the wrong moments. They interrupt meetings, buzz during dinner, and create stress instead of relieving it.

ThoughtTrack is different. It learns your patterns and waits for the right moment.

HOW IT WORKS

• Capture Instantly
Tap the button and speak. Your thought is transcribed and stored in seconds. No typing, no organizing, no friction.

• Let It Drift
Your thoughts enter "drift mode"—a calm holding space where they wait patiently.

• Resurface Naturally
ThoughtTrack considers your calendar, location, time of day, weather and activity before bringing a thought back. Busy in a meeting? It waits. Free on a Saturday morning? Perfect time for that idea about the garden project.

KEY FEATURES

Voice Capture
Tap to record, tap to save. Instant transcription powered by on-device speech recognition. Your voice stays private.

Text Capture
Prefer typing? Tap to type your thought instead.

Intelligent Resurfacing
Context-aware notifications that respect your schedule, location, and focus modes.

Apple Watch App
Capture thoughts from your wrist with the same hold-to-record simplicity. Perfect for those moments when your phone isn't handy.

Home Screen Widgets
Quick capture widget for instant access. See your latest thoughts at a glance.

Siri & Quick Actions
"Capture a text thought" or "Capture a voice thought" — just ask Siri. Use the Action Button for instant voice capture, or add Control Center toggles for one-tap access.

App Intents & Shortcuts
Build custom automations with the Shortcuts app. Capture thoughts, read back your latest thought, or let go of thoughts — all without opening the app.

Privacy First
All transcription happens on-device. Your thoughts are yours alone. iCloud sync keeps everything secure across your devices.

WHO IT'S FOR

• People with busy minds who have ideas throughout the day
• Anyone tired of forgetting that thing they wanted to remember
• Those who find traditional task managers overwhelming
• People who want a calmer relationship with their thoughts

ThoughtTrack isn't a to-do list. It's a memory companion—a gentle system that holds your thoughts until you're ready for them.
